title: Ideation Canvas - Physics-Based Block Visualization

summary.goal: Replace the current ideation session view with a physics-based canvas where blocks visualize crystallizing concepts. Three-column layout (forming blocks | chat | curated blocks) with progressive revelation, focus mode for editing, and dashboard for session management. Solves the 'did you understand me?' problem through user-validated blocks before planner handoff.

problem_statement.current_state: Specialists produce freeform observations. The existing session view has a right sidebar with specialist cards. Users have no clear checkpoint to validate understanding before planning.
problem_statement.user_pain: How do I know the agents understood my idea correctly? I'd need to read a PRD after planning and fine-tune it.
problem_statement.gap: No intermediate artifact users can validate. No visual representation of concept maturity. No clear curation workflow.

dual_output.understanding: Domain observations, concerns, patterns - the 'color' that informs HOW to plan (shown in AI Understanding panel)
dual_output.blocks: Crystallized concepts - the 'substance' that informs WHAT to plan (shown on physics canvas)

proposed_solution.physics_canvas: matter.js simulation where blocks form, grow with content, and seek attention based on confidence
proposed_solution.curation_workflow: Blocks progress through lifecycle (forming → curated), user explicitly curates before handoff
proposed_solution.session_dashboard: Physics-based dashboard showing all sessions as blocks, with Navigator agent for guidance

acceptance_criteria.description: Session canvas has three-column layout: forming blocks (physics ~30%) | chat (~45%) | curated blocks (~25%)
Blocks use matter.js physics: zero gravity with central attraction, collision, drag/shake on release
Block lifecycle: forming (0-30%) → emerging (30-60%) → developing (60-90%) → ready (90%+) → curated
Block SIZE driven by content amount (mini-spec detail); ATTENTION effects (glow/pulse) driven by confidence (0-100%)
Progressive revelation: 0-30% = tiny ~20px dot (not clickable), 30-60% = 40-60px (clickable), 60-90% = 60-100px (full), 90%+ = glow/pulse
Focus mode: clicking block transitions to detail panel (replaces physics column) + contextual chat
User edits in focus mode are authoritative (AI doesn't overwrite), highlighted with color tint, and versioned
Curate action moves block from physics area to right column with green accent border
Auto-curation setting: user can enable auto-curation above configurable threshold (default 90%)
AI Understanding panel (slide-in drawer): idea summary, overall confidence bar, specialist perspectives with synthesized 'takes'
Handoff dialog handles un-curated blocks: leave out, include as context, or include all above X% threshold
Session dashboard: physics blocks for sessions (left ~30%), Navigator meta-chat (center ~45%), sent-to-planner column (right ~25%)
Dashboard: Initiative gravity wells + color coding group related sessions (same Initiative = same color tint)
Dashboard: Abandoned sessions shrink to ~10x10px and drift toward edges (parking lot pattern)
User can explicitly delete blocks (AI misunderstood or changed perspective)
Header: ← Back (to dashboard), session title dropdown (switch sessions), AI Understanding button, → Planner button
Specialist presence indicators: subtle avatars in header (filled = active, empty = idle), click opens AI Understanding focused on specialist
Session switching via header dropdown or Cmd+K command palette
URL structure: /ideation (dashboard), /ideation/session/:id (canvas), /ideation/session/:id?block=:blockId (focused)
Auto-save: sessions save continuously, no explicit Save button needed
Dashboard sent-to-planner column: static list with status badges (Planning, Plan Ready, Approved), click opens Planner view
AI Understanding panel has Deep Insight mode (future): expand specialist card to see raw <object>:<keys>:<fields> data
User settings: auto-curate threshold (default 90%), auto-curate enabled (default false), block visibility threshold (default 30%), theme (default System)
Physics blocks rendered as positioned HTML divs (not canvas) for rich content support
Both light mode (sandy/warm) and dark mode (mission control) themes supported from start

decisions.rationale: More engaging, matches existing mockup, better represents organic concept formation
Clear separation of forming (draft) vs curated blocks; chat stays central
User can see both how much is in a block AND how confident the AI is about it
More immersive editing, contextual chat enables refinement via conversation
User validation is the core value prop; auto-curation is opt-in for power users
Doesn't obscure canvas, can view while keeping context
Same agent as Interviewer but broader context; guides user across sessions
User may want to remove blocks AI misunderstood or that are no longer relevant
If same concept exists in multiple sessions under one Initiative, Planner handles consolidation - keeps Ideation scope clean
No animation needed; static list with status badges is sufficient for sent sessions
Plan ahead for mobile; canvas shows chat primarily, blocks in dropdowns/sequence. Dashboard mobile TBD.
Canvas element can't render rich content; positioned divs allow markdown, emoji, styled text

observations: Physics engine (matter.js) requires careful performance tuning for many blocks
Three-column layout needs flexible sizing for focus mode transitions
Block schema evolves: add confidence, keyword, emoji, userEdits[], remove maturity
Real-time updates via SSE for blocks, WebSocket for chat
Session dashboard reuses physics engine with different block semantics (sessions vs concepts)
Navigator agent is same codebase as Interviewer with different context/prompts
StatusBar package creates cross-app dependency - need clean interface
Gravity wells for Initiatives require physics force field implementation
concerns: Performance with many physics bodies (>50 blocks)
Smooth transitions between normal and focus mode
State management for nested views (canvas within dashboard)
Physics engine cleanup on unmount to prevent memory leaks
SSE reconnection handling for block updates

observations: Physics-based UI is engaging but needs clear visual hierarchy
Confidence thresholds create progressive revelation (dots → blocks → glowing blocks)
Focus mode requires clear visual transition and escape hatch (Close button)
Dashboard gravity wells need subtle visual grouping (dashed boundaries, color tints) without clutter
User edits must be visually distinct from AI content (subtle highlight tint)
AI Understanding panel shows synthesized 'takes' not raw bullet points
Theme support (light sandy/warm, dark mission control) must be consistent with planner
concerns: Accessibility for physics interactions (keyboard navigation for blocks?)
Clear differentiation between session blocks and concept blocks
Color coding for Initiatives must be accessible (not just color, add pattern/badge)

observations: User edits stored with version history - need proper sanitization
SSE connections need authentication token validation
Block content is markdown - XSS considerations for rendering
concerns: Markdown rendering must sanitize user input
Session access control - users should only see their sessions

proposed_architecture.session_dashboard: Physics blocks for sessions + Navigator meta-chat + sent-to-planner column

context.migration_path: New canvas view is additive. Can coexist with current session view during development. Toggle between views for comparison.

notes: This feature supersedes ideation-concrete-blocks. The core concept remains (blocks as user-validatable artifacts) but the implementation changes significantly: physics canvas instead of treemap, three-column layout instead of sidebar, focus mode instead of modal. See docs/design/ideation-canvas-ux.md for comprehensive UX specification.
